import { parseISO, subDays, subMonths, subYears, startOfYear } from 'date-fns'

export function calculateDateRange(dateRange, effectiveCurrentDate) {
  if (!effectiveCurrentDate) {
    return { startDate: null, endDate: null }
  }
  
  const endDate = parseISO(effectiveCurrentDate)
  let startDate

  switch (dateRange) {
    case '1d':
      startDate = subDays(endDate, 1)
      break
    case '1w':
      startDate = subDays(endDate, 7)
      break
    case '1m':
      startDate = subMonths(endDate, 1)
      break
    case '3m':
      startDate = subMonths(endDate, 3)
      break
    case '6m':
      startDate = subMonths(endDate, 6)
      break
    case '1y':
      startDate = subYears(endDate, 1)
      break
    case 'ytd':
      startDate = startOfYear(endDate)
      break
    default:
      startDate = subYears(endDate, 1) // Default to 1 year
  }

  return { startDate, endDate }
}
